note: Suggestions are listed for review. None has been implemented. Implementation starts only after a path is chosen.

rows.summary: What kind of site this should be.

options.label: Buyer's guide publication (proposed default)
options.desc: Question-led guides that link to listings; category pages; disclosure everywhere.
options.tradeoff: Slower to build; strongest long-term fit with the editorial hypotheses.

options.label: Product comparison directory
options.desc: Tables and filters for the five products and more.
options.tradeoff: Needs a much larger, verified product dataset (FLG-001 must be resolved first).

options.label: Deal and trend news
options.desc: Frequent short posts on listing changes.
options.tradeoff: Needs price data (blocked by policy §2(b) without PA-API) and fast refresh.

rows.summary: How product links should be formed once validated.

options.label: Keep the supplied short links (current)
options.desc: Links are used as supplied and marked sponsored.
options.tradeoff: Compliance status unresolved (FLG-003).

options.label: Test one link per product, then switch to tagged /dp/ Special Links (proposed default)
options.desc: Run the validation plan; on success, use https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>?tag=shopnow047c-20 with ASINs confirmed by the owner.
options.tradeoff: Requires owner to confirm intended ASINs (FLG-001).

options.label: Use Amazon-generated links only
options.desc: Create every link in the Associates link builder.
options.tradeoff: Manual step for each product; slower.

rows.summary: Where outbound clicks and page views should go.

options.label: Self-hosted privacy analytics (e.g., on an owned server)
options.desc: Server receives events; no cookies; short retention.
options.tradeoff: Needs hosting; not possible on GitHub Pages alone.

options.label: Cloud function endpoint (e.g., Worker) logging events only
options.desc: Counts clicks and page views with no cookies; keeps the static site.
options.tradeoff: Needs an account and a deployed endpoint; the IP address reaches the host.

options.label: Third-party analytics with consent banner
options.tradeoff: Consent UI needed; less privacy-preserving than A/B.

rows.status: Awaiting your choice — endpoint not configured

rows.summary: How often a new guide is published.

options.label: Weekly
options.tradeoff: Higher editorial load.

options.label: Every two weeks (proposed default)
options.desc: Balance of quality and learning speed.
options.tradeoff: Slower signal.

options.label: Monthly
options.tradeoff: Slowest learning.

rows.summary: Whether prices appear on the site.

options.label: No prices (current)
options.tradeoff: Less purchase context on the page.

options.label: Prices via PA-API / Creators API after eligibility
options.desc: Allowed under policy §2(b) with the API License.
options.tradeoff: Needs API access and attribution rules.

options.label: Typographic design, no product photos (current)
options.tradeoff: Less visual appeal for products.

options.label: Licensed stock photography
options.tradeoff: Licence cost; must not imply Amazon endorsement.

options.label: Owner-shot photos after hands-on testing
options.tradeoff: Needs products and time.

options.label: Gift-season guide (proposed for Nov–Dec)
options.desc: A question-led gift checklist for kitchen gadgets.
options.tradeoff: Time-bound; needs refresh before the season.

options.label: Evergreen only
options.tradeoff: Less timely traffic.

options.label: Three clusters: air fryers, thermometers, buying questions (current)
options.tradeoff: Thermometer cluster has only one guide so far.

options.label: Add a thermometer-buying guide next
options.tradeoff: Adds to editorial load.

options.label: Editorial team byline (current)
options.tradeoff: Less personal trust signal.

options.label: Named author with a real bio
options.tradeoff: Needs owner-supplied details.

rows.status: Awaiting your choice — needs owner input

options.label: HTML meta tag verification
options.desc: Simple, runs on the static site.
options.tradeoff: Needs an edit to the template with the token.

options.label: DNS verification of a custom domain
options.tradeoff: Needs a custom domain.
